title: Veterans Pension Retroactive Release for Months Already Paid at a Lower Rate
content:
# Retroactive release after a rate increase — Veterans Pension

When a rate adjustment raises the annual Veterans Pension from an effective date that lies before months already paid, the higher amount for those months is released as one retroactive payment.

> A retroactive release for months already paid is not issued until the award carries a rate adjustment that raises the annual pension for those months.

Equivalently: as long as the award carries no rate adjustment raising the annual pension for those months, no retroactive release for them is issued.

**What the release names and covers.** The release names the raising adjustment and runs from the month of that adjustment's effective date through the entitlement month of the most recent monthly payment.

| Element of the release | Value |
|---|---|
| Adjustment named | the raising rate adjustment |
| First month covered | the month of that adjustment's effective date |
| Last month covered | the entitlement month of the most recent monthly payment |
| Number of payments | one |

## Release tool: `release_retro_payment_a1af7a43`

**Capability.** It releases to the veteran one retroactive Veterans Pension payment covering a span of entitlement months under a rate adjustment. One call adds one retroactive payment entry to the award, issued that day and delivered in full with nothing withheld — the net amount equals the gross amount. Nothing else on the award changes.

**Invocation.** The agent unlocks `release_retro_payment_a1af7a43` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `pension_award_id` | the reference number of the Veterans Pension award being paid, as shown by the pension award lookup for this veteran | identifier |
| `adjustment_id` | the reference number of the rate adjustment the release is made under, as shown by the pension income report lookup or returned when that adjustment was recorded | identifier |
| `retro_period_start` | the first entitlement month covered | YYYY-MM |
| `retro_period_end` | the last entitlement month covered | YYYY-MM |
| `gross_amount` | the amount released, in USD | decimal with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** On success, one sentence of the form "Retroactive payment <payment reference> released on award <award reference>: <amount> USD for <first month> to <last month>, issued <today's date>." The amount is shown with 2 decimal places and the issue date is the current date as YYYY-MM-DD. Receiving this sentence means the payment has been issued; the veteran can see the released amount and the months it covers. The tool defines no other outcome.

*Illustration (hypothetical):* a raising adjustment effective 2026-01-01 on an award whose most recent monthly payment was for the entitlement month of March 2026 is released with `retro_period_start` 2026-01 and `retro_period_end` 2026-03.
